Rina (People Ops): Quick Q — Jamie submitted per diem for a 3-day dev conference in Lisbon but the conference package included lunch on day 2 and a networking dinner on day 3. They claimed full per diem all three days. How should we prorate?
Mateo: Per-diem gets reduced for employer/organizer-provided meals. We subtract the meal allowance for each provided meal from that day's per-diem. Use the country/day rate table in the wiki.
Jamie: I only noticed the dinner after I uploaded expenses — conference email attached said "lunch included" for day 2 and "networking dinner" on day 3 but no itemized menu or value.
Finance Ops: We can accept the conference agenda or organizer confirmation as proof. If theres no itemized value, we apply the standard meal deduction amounts: breakfast $8, lunch $18, dinner $28 (local currency equivalents). Please attach the agenda screenshot or registration confirmation.
Conference Bot: Tip: Attach PDFs or PNGs. Filename should include date and event, e.g., 2026-04-02-lisbon-agenda.pdf.
Rina (People Ops): Can we also clarify how to handle cases where the attendee paid for the provided meal (e.g., team had a paid group dinner) — do we still deduct?
Mateo: If the employee paid out-of-pocket and has a receipt for that vendor meal, do not deduct from per-diem; reimburse the vendor meal as usual. If the organizer paid the bill, then deduct the meal from per-diem.
Finance Ops: Also, for foreign per-diem claims include the card statement showing the charge if you used a card, or use the banks conversion on the statement. If they claim in USD but receipts are in EUR, ask them to show the original EUR amounts and the USD converted amount (bank rate).
Jamie: OK I can attach the conference confirmation and note I paid nothing for those two meals (they were included), so I expect the per-diem reduction.
Rina (People Ops): Can someone paste the exact text we should send Jamie so this is clear? Ill reply and update the receipts wiki.
Mateo: Send: "Please attach a copy of the conference agenda/confirmation showing which meals are included. We'll deduct the standard meal values from daily per-diem for any organizer-provided meals. If you paid for a meal yourself, attach the receipt and we'll reimburse it instead of deducting. For foreign claims, include the card statement or show the original currency plus the USD conversion used. Manager approval will be requested for per-diem adjustments over $25."
Finance Ops: Add: "If no agenda is available, submit a screenshot of the registration confirmation or an email from the organizer. Manager sign-off required when we can't verify meal inclusion."
Rina (People Ops): Perfect — I'll reply and add this wording to the per-diem FAQ with an example calculation. Thanks folks :memo: :thumbsup:
